```swift func nextRecordZoneChangeBatch( _ context: CKSyncEngine.SendChangesContext, syncEngine: CKSyncEngine ) async -> CKSyncEngine.RecordZoneChangeBatch? { // Get the pending record changes and filter by the context's scope. let pendingChanges = syncEngine.state.pendingRecordZoneChanges .filter { context.options.zoneIDs.contains($0) } // Return a change batch that contains the corresponding materialized records. return await CKSyncEngine.RecordZoneChangeBatch( pendingChanges: pendingChanges) { self.recordFor(id: $0) } } ```
